name: ORC-mkV Arms Crusader Edition
description:

Damage Reduction: 30%

Radiation Protection: 26400 REM

Dependable and durable armor never goes out of style. The ORC-mkV from Clark Defense Systems has been a battlefield staple for centuries. This highly regarded medium armor blends composite plating with a special fiber reinforced polymer to provide solid protection and a wide range of movement. The Crusader Edition was made specifically for the company's security services.
